title: Law of the exact sparse-spectrum learner
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, and let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a target function. The outcome law of the exact sparse-spectrum learner is the point mass at the output and learning cost obtained by running its deterministic query procedure against $f$.
hypotheses_covered: target Boolean function on the n-dimensional sign cube
